title: Chapter 4: The Official Record
notes: Revised CH04 (The Official Record). Proposed dialogue pending narrative review. Scenes 01, 02, 03 and 05: Voss's meeting keeps the transfer audit and the spatial survey as separate incident files; the junior summary's 'confirmed mapping error' is corrected with the first version kept; Rahman states the clinical boundary; an outside reviewer finds a time-order contradiction that cannot be removed without excluding an original. Not built in this slice: Scene 04 (Mara's follow-up: clinical conversation needing approval) and Scene 06 (personal call: no personal-history system). The Scene 09 corridor-loop reveal waits for the owner's approval of its effect. Scenes 07-08 (Door-state replication attempt, Institutional disagreement): a controlled, continuously watched check of the lift lobby doors; nothing happens during the watch, and the result cannot exclude an authorized entry between the original checks, so repeatability stays open (no 'corroborated' from repeated logs). Voss, Hale and Rahman agree patient care continues and the restriction stands; the player proposes external verification, a coordinated briefing or documented dissent; safety notifications happen regardless.

objectives.text: Dr Voss has called Hale, Facilities and you to her office area.
An administrative summary is waiting at the office workstation.
Dr Rahman wants a word at the office desk.
The outside reviewer's comparison is on the Records worksheet.
Hale is setting up a controlled check of the lobby doors. Join him at Interview Room A's door.
Watch the lift lobby doors with the team for the controlled check.
Return the test pass to Hale.
Voss is meeting Hale and Rahman about access and patient continuity.

staff_lines.text: Lobby doors, the team, a watch that doesn't blink. That's the test.
Different questions, different evidence. Come and find me when it's a clinical one.
Nobody enters pending the independent safety review.
Two incident files. Keep them that way.

interactions.title: Dr Voss: the morning after
interactions.body:
Voss: We are not here to settle a theory. We have observations we can't yet reconcile and a restricted area with possible safety implications.

Engineer: Some old plans are incomplete. Other differences remain unexplained.

Hale: Nobody enters pending the independent safety review.

You: The inactive-credential transfer request remains an information-security question.

Voss: Precisely. Don't join two incomplete cases just because their labels resemble each other.

options.label: Propose one combined W0-B case file
options.response: Voss: No. The transfer audit and the spatial survey are separate incident files until something other than a label connects them.

options.label: Preserve transparent findings in both files
options.response: Voss: Good. Both files say what was observed and what wasn't.

options.label: Focus on the access restrictions first
options.response: Hale: Then we agree. The restriction stays until the safety review signs off.

options.label: Request outside expertise for the survey
options.response: Voss: I'll ask for an outside reviewer. The safety review still comes first.

interactions.title: Administrative summary (draft)
interactions.body:
A junior administrator's draft summary of the Chapter 3 inspection reads: "Cause: confirmed mapping error." No review has established a cause. Facilities' own file says unresolved.

Voss (note): Then the summary is wrong. Correct it. Keep the first version in the revision history.

options.label: Leave "confirmed mapping error" as the finding
options.response: Not established. A mapping error is one candidate explanation; no review has confirmed it. The draft stays open for revision.

options.label: Replace it with "anomalous geometry confirmed"
options.response: Not established either. Nothing the inspection recorded supports that wording. The draft stays open for revision.

options.label: State the observed contradiction and that the cause is unresolved
options.response: Official finding entered: plan editions and observations disagree; cause unresolved; independent review pending. The first draft is kept in the revision history.

interactions.completed_body: Official finding: contradiction observed, cause unresolved. Revision history kept.

interactions.title: Dr Rahman: clinical boundary
interactions.body: Rahman: An unusual facilities report doesn't change the standards for evaluating a patient who is distressed or sleeping poorly.

options.label: Suggest the corridor report might explain some patients' distress
options.response: Rahman: No. A building report isn't a clinical finding, and a patient's distress isn't building evidence. We assess the patient.

options.label: "And an old psychiatric diagnosis doesn't prove an audit record false."
options.response: Rahman: Both are important. Different questions need different evidence.

interactions.title: Outside review: retained originals
interactions.body:
The outside reviewer compared the retained originals after accounting for the known export display differences. A time-order contradiction remains. How independent the originals are is documented, not assumed.

Analyst: I can't make these versions agree without excluding one of the originals.

options.label: Exclude the original that doesn't fit
options.response: Excluding a record to make the others agree would destroy the contradiction, not resolve it.

options.label: "Then preserve them both. Identify which checks were performed."
options.response: Both originals preserved. Checks listed: display-difference correction, clock-source comparison, custody trail. Independence documented per record. The time-order contradiction stands.

interactions.completed_body: Retained originals: time-order contradiction preserved with the checks performed.

interactions.title: Marcus Hale: controlled check
interactions.body: Hale: Facilities wants to see whether the lobby door does it again. Authorized test, continuous watch, access logs pulled before and after. You come as the person who logged it the first time.

options.label: Join the controlled check
options.response: Test pass logged: ward entry only, for this check. The lobby doors themselves stay locked.

interactions.title: Restricted lift lobby doors: controlled check
interactions.body:
The doors are closed and latched. The team watches them continuously for the agreed interval. Nothing moves. The analyst pulls the access log and the mechanical inspection notes.

Hale: Can the records establish there was no authorized entry between checks?

Analyst: Not yet. We'll preserve the access logs and mechanical inspection results.

options.label: Mark the first door event corroborated by the second log
options.response: The second log came from the same logging system as the first, and nothing happened during the watch. Two entries from one system are not independent corroboration.

options.label: "Then repeatability is still an open question."
options.response: Recorded: controlled watch with no door movement; an authorized entry between the original checks is not excluded; logs and inspection results preserved. Repeatability open.

interactions.unavailable_body: The lobby doors are behind the ward entry.
interactions.completed_body: Controlled check: no movement during the watch; repeatability open; logs preserved.

interactions.title: Marcus Hale: end of the check
interactions.body: Hale: Pass back, please. The restriction stands.

options.label: Return the test pass
options.response: Test pass returned. The ward entry doors are controlled access again.

interactions.title: Dr Voss: access and continuity
interactions.body:
Voss, Hale and Rahman around the desk.

Rahman: Patient care must continue regardless of the investigation.

Hale: The site restriction stands until safety criteria are met.

Voss: We can meet both obligations. What we cannot do is issue a false explanation.

The required safety notifications have already gone out.

options.label: Suggest holding the safety notification until there's an explanation
options.response: Voss: No. Notifications go out whatever we think the explanation is. They already have.

options.label: Propose external verification
options.response: Voss: Agreed. An outside team with its own instruments, under Hale's restriction.

options.label: Propose a coordinated briefing for all three services
options.response: Voss: One briefing, three obligations: care, safety, record. I'll schedule it.

options.label: Formally document your dissent on the pace of the review
options.response: Voss: Noted in the record under your name. The restriction and the care plan stand.

sign_out.title: Clinical handoff
sign_out.undocumented_message: Outstanding clinical review still requires an appropriate handoff.
